headline: Independent remote scans put China's interference rate at 4.38%
dek: Censored Planet supplies an outside-in method that is independent of OONI's in-country volunteer probes.

claims.statement: Censored Planet's current remote side-channel measurement reports a 4.38% China interference rate.

method.summary: ingests Censored Planet's public aggregated data; probes nothing (vantage-insensitive)

limitations: The remote-scan denominator and method differ from OONI's anomaly index, so their percentages are not interchangeable.
